View Pomme guest-agent unified logs.

```text
pomme log [NAME] [--last LAST] [--follow] [--category CATEGORY ...] [--level LEVEL] [--format FORMAT] [--json] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--last LAST` | History window: a positive number followed by s, m, h, or d; or boot. |
| `--follow` | Stream new records until interrupted. |
| `--category CATEGORY` | Include an exact Pomme log category. Repeat to combine categories. |
| `--level LEVEL` | Minimum log level: default, info, or debug. Values: `default`, `info`, `debug`. Default: `info`. |
| `--format FORMAT` | Output format: text, json, or jsonl. Values: `text`, `json`, `jsonl`. |
| `--json` | Print JSON records. Equivalent to `--format json`. |
| `--debug` | Print verbose CLI diagnostics. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
